notes: First SK run 2026-11-02. 24 h (explicit on clinic/university page): Košice - UVLF Univerzitná veterinárna nemocnica (nepretržitá pohotovosť; weekday nights by emergency phone 20:00-8:00); Bratislava - Vetline, SmallVet Plus (weekday 20-9 on call, weekends round the clock), Marfilvet (page inconsistent: meta says 20:00-22:00, body says 24 h); Žilina - Veterinárna klinika Žilina (vet on site 24 h), Klinika Fénix (on-call line); Nitra - Pet Clinic; Nové Zámky - Veterinárna poliklinika; Trnava - Tri-Vet (Cífer), SCAR Vet; Poprad - Veterinárna pohotovosť (Zatroch/CENTRUM); Martin - Záturčie (24 h for regular clients only). Not marked 24 h although close: Cassovet Košice (own page: emergency to 24:00; a 2021 news article said non-stop), PrimaVet and MyPet Bratislava (to 24:00), X-vet (meta description only), Prešov clinics, Banská Bystrica clinics (Petservis to 22:00), ELPA Trenčín (weekend to 19:00), VET-Centrum Nitra (to 22:00). No 24-h clinic was found for Banská Bystrica, Trenčín or Prešov (Prešov clinics refer to UVLF Košice). Duty rotas: Slovakia has no national or chamber rota that could be opened; the Slovenská komora veterinárnych lekárov site (skvl.sk) and ŠVPS pages were not reachable/usable in this run (fetch provenance block / no duty list in search results). The only duty page included is the UVLF Košice pohotovosť page. Poison line: none included - no opened page states that the Národné toxikologické informačné centrum (NTIC Bratislava) advises on animal poisonings, so no poison_line entry exists. Left out: Poprad clinic NahalkaVet and Košice V kit ambulances (only aggregator pages tippytaps/bestvet claim 24/7; own sites not found), VETANIMAL Košice (nonstop discontinued 2021 per news article), Žilina clinic Facebook pages, Trenčín/Martin/Nové Zámky smaller practices, Bratislava VetPoint and BullyPet (no own page opened). Aggregators (tippytaps, bestvet, modrypsik, petla) used only to discover names. INDEPENDENT CHECK 2026-11-02: source_url opened for 17 entries (all 24-h clinics, the UVLF duty rota, and a random 20% of the rest: Cassovet, Petservis, BBVET, Vetpo); all names/phones confirmed, no phone fixes. UVLF Košice clinic and Marfilvet downgraded from 24 h (see their notes); Martin-Záturčie and SmallVet Plus kept 24 h with conditional notes. No poison line entries present. Nothing removed.
